Name: Cropgenics
Author: Owenynk112
Description:
[b][color=#ffd966][size=5]1.Description[/size][/color][/b]
[b]Cropgenics[/b] turns ordinary farming into a living breeding garden — still cozy, but with more to observe, collect, and discover.
Your [b][color=#6aa84f]crops can now develop natural mutations. [/color][/b][b]Take samples, identify their traits, breed those traits into stable varieties[/b], and [b][color=#ead1dc]slowly build a farm that feels truly your own.[/color][/b]

[b][color=#3d85c6]Some traits are practical[/color]: [/b]faster growth and regrowth, higher yields, better quality, and more. 
[b][color=#d5a6bd]Others are purely magical or decorative[/color]:[/b] soft night glow, butterflies, fireflies, petal rain, bubbles, and other visual surprises.

Cropgenics also adds[b] l[color=#ffff00]egendary rare flowers[/color][/b], [color=#38761d]a handwritten [b]Breeding Almanac[/b][/color],[color=#c27ba0] [b]crop photography[/b],[/color] [color=#3c78d8][b]exhibitions[/b][/color], and [color=#ff0000]t[b]wo new characters[/b][/color]: [color=#6aa84f][b]Fernando[/b], [b]a forest botanist[/b],[/color] and [color=#d5a6bd][b]Oriko[/b], [b]a wandering flower-seeker.[/b][/color]
Available in [color=#ff0000][b]Simplified Chinese[/b] and [b]English[/b][/color].


New in 1.0.5 Species-Specific Crop Traits
[b]Potato → Potato Battery [/b]Harvesting has a chance to [color=#3c78d8]produce a [b]Battery Pack[/b][/color].
[b]Ancient Fruit → Ancient Companion [/b]Harvesting has [color=#6aa84f]a chance to produce a [b]Dinosaur Egg[/b][/color].
[b]Strawberry → Mountain Wind [/b]Harvesting produces a [color=#e06666][b]Mountain Wind Strawberry[/b].[/color] Eating it grants a short burst of movement speed.
[b]Blueberry → Glow Berry [/b]Harvesting produces a [b][color=#3c78d8]Glow Berry[/color][/b]. Eating it makes you emit a soft cyan glow for a short time.
[b]Corn → Corn Cannon [/b]Harvesting corn can [color=#ffff00]unlock the [b]Corn Cannon[/b][/color] once per player: a special slingshot that only uses corn as ammo. Its shots explode on impact.
[b]Hops → Overripe Hops [/b]Once the vine is mature, it [color=#00ff00]automatically harvests itself each day.[/color]
[line]

[b][color=#ffff00][size=5]Main Features [/size][/color][/b]
[heading][color=#00ff00]1. The Breeding Loop[/color][/heading]
Once the system is unlocked, any crop may develop a [b][color=#93c47d]natural mutation[/color][/b] when it matures.
Use the [b]Pruning Shears[/b] to take a sample. Inspect the sample, identify its trait, and breed that trait into a stable variety. 
New seeds can inherit these traits across generations and eventually breed true.
[color=#38761d][b]Traits can change the way you farm.[/b][/color]

Cropgenics is not meant to be only a profit-focused farming overhaul. It also adds new reasons to observe, decorate, collect, record, and show off your crops.
[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782224926-125509750.gif[/img][/b]
[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782224931-1894796464.gif[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782224925-760375193.gif[/img][/b]
[line]

[color=#ffff00][size=4][b]2. Legendary Rare Flowers [/b][/size][/color]
Beyond ordinary traits, the valley hides [color=#ffe599]several legendary rare flowers[/color].
These [b][color=#6d9eeb]rare species only grow under specific ecological conditions[/color][/b]: the right neighboring crops, weather, season, time, or environment.
The [b]Breeding Almanac[/b] records clues, but the valley does not reveal every answer immediately.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782225434-1329454433.png[/img]
There are currently [color=#ff7700]nine known legendary rare flowers to cultivate[/color], plus[color=#3c78d8][b] one mysterious flower closely tied to the main story. [/b][/color]
[line]

[b][color=#fff2cc][size=4]3. Record Your Discoveries [/size][/color][/b]
Your discoveries do not end at harvest.
The handwritten [b]Breeding Almanac[/b] records the traits and rare species you discover.
You can also [b][color=#6aa84f]photograph your favorite crops[/color][/b], preserve important moments, and eventually [b][color=#ffff00]display your best flowers in the Exhibition Tent beside the Community Center.[/color][/b]
With the right tools, your farm becomes more than a production space. It becomes a living collection.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782661285-1433667199.png[/img]
[line]

[color=#f9cb9c][size=5]4.The Two Newcomers[/size][/color]
[heading][color=#1155cc]1.Fernando — Romanceable[/color][/heading]
[color=#6aa84f][b]Fernando is a botanist[/b][/color] who left the paperwork of [b]Zuzu City University[/b] behind for a half-collapsed cabin south of [b][color=#b6d7a8]Cindersap Forest[/color][/b], where he studies the valley’s unusually active plant life.
Precise, dry, and quietly self-deprecating, he [color=#a4c2f4]runs on coffee and stubbornness[/color]. He is kinder than his spreadsheets suggest. [b][color=#00ff00]Fernando serves as your guide into crop breeding.[/color][/b]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782227961-394584649.png[/img]
[b][color=#d5a6bd][size=4]2.Oriko — Romanceable [/size][/color][/b]
[b][color=#c27ba0]Oriko is a traveler[/color][/b] who has walked stranger roads than most. [color=#674ea7][b]Gentle and poetic[/b][/color], with a sword’s edge beneath the surface, she came to Pelican Town chasing a childhood memory: a single blue rose that glowed in the dark and led her safely down a mountain.
Now, she [color=#ffff00][b]searches for the valley’s other legendary flowers.[/b][/color]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782224570-53032882.png[/img]

[line]
[b][size=5]How Does Breeding Work? [/size][/b]
[list=1]
1.Use the Pruning Shears to collect a sample.[/list][list=1]
A mature crop can provide a parent sample. A mutated crop can provide a source sample carrying a trait.[/list][list=1]
2.Inspect the samples at the Breeding Station.[/list][list=1]
3.Combine a source sample with a parent sample to breed a new crop variety. You will receive 3–5 next-generation seeds. [/list][list=1]
These seeds inherit traits from the source sample and can be used as new parent lines. [/list]  [b]     [color=#b45f06] Some traits have levels. Breeding with a matching trait-bearing parent can raise that trait’s level.[/color][/b]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782660607-2066978800.png[/img]
[b][color=#ff7700][size=5]Breed your way into the story. [/size][/color][/b]

[b][color=#ff00ff]Progression Tips [/color][/b]
If you do not want to get stuck during the Cropgenics main story, these tips may help.
[list=1]
1.Natural mutations only begin appearing after your first Bus Stop encounter.[/list][list=1]
2.A mutated crop does not lock in its final trait immediately. The trait is rolled when you sample it with the Pruning Shears. This matters for traits tied to festivals, weather, time of day, or other special conditions.[/list][list=1]
3.Starting from Fall 1, pruning crops during certain major festival days may grant festival-themed traits. A good strategy is to prepare around 5 naturally mutated crops in advance and prune them on the festival day.[/list][list=1]
4.Try to complete the task of cultivating a level-5 trait early. This unlocks trait extraction, making it much easier to transfer useful traits between crop lines.[/list][list=1]
5.Reaching 6 hearts with Fernando unlocks a machine for mass-breeding a chosen crop line. Combined with trait extraction, this greatly speeds up variety expansion and trait transfer.[/list][line]

[spoiler]Main Story Triggers
Spoilers below.
[heading]1. Meet Fernando — Bus Stop[/heading]
Trigger:
On a Sunday, meaning the 7th, 14th, 21st, or 28th, visit the [b]Bus Stop[/b] between 06:00 and 17:00.
If you miss it, try again next Sunday.
[line]
[heading]2. Forest Lab Intro — Receive the Pruning Shears[/heading]
Trigger:
On a later day, not the same day as the Bus Stop encounter, visit [b]Cindersap Forest[/b] between 06:00 and 17:00.
You will receive the [b]Pruning Shears[/b].
Use them on mature crops showing natural trait signs to collect crop samples. Sampling consumes the crop.
[line]
[heading]3. Festival Traits — Farm Event[/heading]
This is the entrance to Oriko’s storyline.
Trigger:
On the farm, on a sunny day, between 06:00 and 11:30, after festival traits have been unlocked and after you have planted or harvested a crop carrying a hidden festival trait.
Attending certain festivals may imprint hidden traits onto crops, such as:
Moonlit
North Star
Foxfire
Fragrant
Garland
After planting or harvesting a crop with the corresponding hidden trait, a related farm event may trigger on the next sunny morning.
[line]
[heading]4. Meet Oriko — Adventurer’s Guild[/heading]
Trigger:
After completing the festival-trait step, Oriko’s introduction letter will arrive.
Read the letter, then visit the [b]Adventurer’s Guild[/b].
Oriko will appear and tell you about the legend of the [b]Blue Moon Fairy[/b]. The rare-species pages of the Breeding Almanac will begin to open.
[line]
[heading]5. Breed the Blue Moon Fairy — Lab Event[/heading]
Recipe clue:
On a [b]Fairy Rose[/b], stabilize the key traits:
Azure
Moonlit
Star-Veined
at level 3.
This can produce the [b]Blue Moon Fairy[/b].
Afterward, record or place it in Fernando’s laboratory, then enter the lab at night between 20:00 and 02:00 to trigger the next scene.
[line]
[heading]6. Exhibition Tent[/heading]
After the Blue Moon Fairy storyline, the reward chain begins.
Oriko will send a proposal letter.
Read the letter, meet Robin at the [b]Carpenter’s Shop[/b], and place the required materials into Robin’s material box.
That night, Robin will build the [b]Exhibition Tent[/b] beside the Community Center.
After the tent is built, you can use day and night visitor passes to invite villagers to pose with your crops for the album.
The Exhibition Tent feature requires the [b]Polaroid Camera[/b].
[line]
Key Items
[heading]Pruning Shears[/heading]
Received during the forest lab intro.
Used to sample mature, trait-bearing crops. Sampling consumes the crop.
[heading]Breeding Station[/heading]
The recipe unlocks after your first sample.
Used to breed and stabilize crop varieties, inspect seed traits, and extract Trait Inducers.
[heading]Magnifying Glass[/heading]
Received from Fernando after his 4-heart forest event.
Used to inspect mutated mature crops and better understand their possible trait outcomes.
[heading]Polaroid Camera[/heading]
A gift from Oriko.
After befriending her, you can receive it when you meet her at the mountain summit.
The Polaroid Camera lets you add crop photos and group shots to the Almanac and Exhibition Album. Get it early, because the Exhibition Tent uses it.
[heading]Rare Species[/heading]
After you breed the [b]Blue Moon Fairy[/b], Oriko will send rare species on the 1st and 15th of each season.
There are two rare species per season.
They cannot be grown in the greenhouse and are very particular about their environment.
If you lose every plant of a rare species, Fernando can send a replacement after a cooldown.[/spoiler]
[line]

[b][color=#ff0000][size=4]Installation[/size][/color][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip Cropgenics into the Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b][color=#ff0000][size=4]Requirements[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/b][/*]
[*][i](Optional)[/i] [i]Generic Mod Config Menu[/i][/*]
[/list][line]
Compatibility
[b][color=#00ff00]Stardew Valley Expanded[/color][/b]: compatibility is included. Events and schedules account for SVE’s reworked maps where possible.
Cropgenics is designed to be broadly compatible with other mods.
Its crop-breeding system should work with most vanilla crops and many mod-added crops, as long as those crops follow Stardew Valley’s normal crop data structure.
[b][color=#cc0000]In general, Cropgenics should be compatible with most mods unless they heavily edit the maps used by this mod, especially:[/color][/b]
[color=#ffe599]Cindersap Forest
Mountain
Town
Community Center area
Bus Stop
Adventurer’s Guild[/color]
If you find a conflict, please report it.



Current State
Cropgenics is still in development.The main systems are playable, but the mod adds new mechanics, maps, NPC schedules, events, tools, UI elements, and custom progression. Bugs or mod conflicts may still occur.
[b]If you find a problem, please provide:[/b]
what happened,where it happened,what you were doing before it happened,your mod list, if relevant

[line]
[b]⚠️ AI Usage Disclosure [/b]
AI tools were used only to assist with some Almanac illustration and UI-style visual assets.
These images were manually selected, edited, adjusted, and integrated to fit the mod’s style and gameplay needs.
[line]
Shout Outs
Special thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community, the SMAPI team, wiki contributors, and everyone who makes modding possible.
Thank you to everyone who tries Cropgenics during development, reports bugs, shares feedback, or simply enjoys growing strange little plants.

Manifest.Name: Cropgenics
Manifest.Description: Cropgenics is a crop-breeding overhaul for Stardew Valley 1.6. Collect natural traits from your harvests, breed and stabilize new varieties, and cultivate nine rare flowers through ecological rituals - all chronicled in the Breeding Almanac. Adds two characters, Fernando and Oriko, with their own story, schedules and events, plus an exhibition tent where villagers pose with your prize crops for album photos. Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded.
